verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents checkpoint-based rollback for its Sprite/agent runtime ('Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds', 'A Sprite checkpoints itself while the agent works'), which covers rollback of agent state, but there is no evidence of version history, diffing, or a review workflow for automations themselves. missing for 10: version history/diff view, review workflow before rollback, independent hands-on confirmation of checkpoint rollback working reliably
